settings_reset_conflict: Another tab has reset the application.
licenses_description: This application's license texts and copyright notices are included locally. The original texts remain unchanged in their original language.
licenses_project_scope: The original code and documentation of regningen are licensed under AGPL-3.0-only. Third-party software, fonts and copied source retain their own license terms.
licenses_data_scope: Your generated invoices and business data do not become AGPL-licensed merely through using this application. Independently included third-party material retains its own terms.
licenses_third_party_description: Notices for delivered browser and server software, fonts, copied source and generated runtime code. Development-only tools are not part of this list.
settings_languages_description: Choose the language of the interface and generated invoices.
settings_invoice_language_hint: Invoice language applies to all subsequent PDF exports. Text you enter stays unchanged.
settings_appearance_description: Choose an appearance or follow your device settings.
settings_notifications_description: Local notifications inform you after a successful PDF export. There are no reminders or messages from a server.
settings_installation_description: Install regningen to open the application directly from your device. Installation does not enable notifications.
settings_reset_description: Delete your locally saved data and preferences in this browser and start again.
settings_reset_failed: Some data may already have been deleted. {error} Check storage settings and try again.
settings_reset_scope: The business profile, all invoice inputs including unsaved changes in this application's tabs, appearance, language preferences, notification preferences and acknowledged release notes will be deleted in this browser. Downloaded PDFs and backups, browser permissions, installation and offline availability are retained. Other browsers and devices are not affected.
settings_discard_description: Your business profile changes have not been saved. Continuing will discard these changes.
